en.headline: Lee targets September release for Hong Kong’s first five-year plan
en.dek: After a district consultation forum, the Chief Executive said the government aims to publish the plan within the third quarter and wants the subsequent Policy Address issued as soon as possible afterwards.

zh.headline: 李家超：目標9月內發表香港首份五年規劃
zh.dek: 特首出席地區諮詢會後表示，五年規劃諮詢本周五結束，政府目標於第三季即9月內發表，其後盡快公布施政報告。

en.headline: Hiker dies after collapsing on Plover Cove Reservoir Country Trail
en.dek: A 64-year-old Filipino man holding a Hong Kong identity card was found unconscious on the trail near Tai Po on Sunday afternoon and was certified dead while being airlifted; police are investigating whether heat…

zh.headline: 大埔船灣郊遊徑男子暈倒 直升機送院途中不治
zh.dek: 周日下午一名64歲持香港身份證的菲律賓籍男子於船灣淡水湖郊遊徑被發現昏迷，飛行服務隊直升機送院途中證實不治，警方調查是否與中暑有關。

en.headline: Five-year-old with chronic illness in serious condition after influenza A
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a case of influenza A (H1) complicated by sepsis; the girl, who had received the 2025/26 seasonal vaccine, remains in the paediatric intensive care unit at Tuen Mun…

zh.headline: 5歲長期病患女童染甲流併發敗血症 情况嚴重
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心調查一宗兒童甲型流感嚴重個案，女童已接種2025/26年度季節性流感疫苗，現於屯門醫院兒童深切治療部留醫，情况嚴重。

en.headline: Air-conditioner fire at Taikoo Shing sends 16 to hospital
en.dek: A suspected short-circuit in a split-type air-conditioner on the 20th floor of Begonia Mansion at Harbour View Gardens caused heavy smoke on Sunday afternoon; about 300 residents were evacuated and more than 20 waited…

zh.headline: 太古城海棠閣冷氣機起火 16人不適送院
zh.dek: 周日下午海景花園海棠閣20樓單位懷疑分體式冷氣機電線短路起火，冒出大量濃煙，約300人疏散，逾20人暫上天台，16人不適送院。

en.headline: Observatory records 36.9°C, new all-time high since 1884
en.dek: Under Severe Typhoon Dolphin’s outer subsiding air, the Hong Kong Observatory headquarters reached 36.9 degrees Celsius by mid-afternoon, while Sheung Shui hit 39.7–39.8 degrees, the highest at any automatic station…

zh.headline: 天文台錄36.9度再破有紀錄最高溫 上水見39.8度
zh.dek: 受強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，天文台總部周日下午錄得36.9度，刷新1884年有紀錄以來最高氣溫，上水自動氣象站更高見39.7至39.8度。

en.headline: Paul Chan expects over 100 mega events in second half to draw 1.85 million visitors
en.dek: The Financial Secretary said first-half events already attracted 1.75 million participants and generated about HK$5.8 billion in spending, with retail sales rising for 14 consecutive months.

zh.headline: 陳茂波：下半年逾100項盛事料吸185萬旅客
zh.dek: 財政司司長在網誌表示，上半年盛事已吸引175萬人次參與並帶來約58億元消費，零售業總銷貨價值連升14個月。

en.headline: Police arrest 147 in triad syndicate linked to HK$600 million laundering
en.dek: A citywide operation code-named Rapidhorse dismantled an alleged triad network running drug dens and illegal gambling, with officers seizing cash, jewellery and weapons after tracing criminal proceeds through puppet…

zh.headline: O記搗三合會洗黑錢集團拘147人 涉逾6億元
zh.dek: 警方代號「捷駒」行動搗破懷疑三合會集團經營毒窟及賭檔，利用傀儡戶口清洗逾6億元犯罪得益，拘捕包括主腦在內共147人。

en.headline: Observatory records 36.8°C, hottest day since records began in 1884
en.dek: Under Severe Typhoon Dolphin’s outer subsiding air, the Hong Kong Observatory headquarters reached a new all-time high of 36.8 degrees Celsius on Sunday afternoon, while Happy Valley hit 38 degrees.

zh.headline: 天文台錄36.8度破有紀錄最高溫 跑馬地見38度
zh.dek: 受強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，天文台總部周日下午錄得36.8度，刷新1884年有紀錄以來最高氣溫，跑馬地更高見38度。

en.headline: Lee says independent building-maintenance agency worth considering
en.dek: At the second district forum on Hong Kong’s first five-year plan and the 2026 Policy Address, the Chief Executive responded to public suggestions on housing, youth development and building repairs.

zh.headline: 李家超：獨立專業機構代辦樓宇維修值得考慮
zh.dek: 特首李家超周日率領司局長出席第二場五年規劃及2026年施政報告地區諮詢會，回應市民就房屋、青年發展及樓宇維修等建議。

en.headline: Observatory records 36.0°C, new high for the year
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory headquarters logged 36.0 degrees Celsius by early afternoon on Sunday under the influence of Severe Typhoon Dolphin’s outer subsiding air, surpassing the previous 2026 peak.

zh.headline: 天文台錄36.0度創今年新高
zh.dek: 受強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，天文台總部周日中午前後錄得36.0度，刷新今年最高氣溫紀錄，新界多區超過37度。

en.headline: Extremely hot start to the work week, showers possible midweek
en.dek: The Observatory expects mainly fine and extremely hot conditions through Tuesday under residual influence from Typhoon Dolphin, with temperatures easing slightly and isolated showers arriving later in the week.

zh.headline: 下周初極端酷熱 中期或有驟雨
zh.dek: 天文台預料強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響下，本周初大致天晴極端酷熱，周中起西南氣流影響，氣溫稍降並可能有局部驟雨。

en.headline: Educators and experts urge stronger regulation of social media for under-16s
en.dek: Calls for legislation or tighter rules to curb addiction and cyberbullying among children intensified on Saturday, with a survey showing majority public support and think-tank suggestions for targeted controls rather…

zh.headline: 教育界及專家倡加強規管16歲以下使用社交媒體
zh.dek: 周六教育界、議員及智庫再呼籲加強規管未成年使用社交平台，指成癮及網絡欺凌問題嚴重，民調顯示逾六成市民支持立法限制16歲以下使用。

en.headline: Two hikers airlifted after heat illness on hottest day of the year
en.dek: A 28-year-old man near Po Pin Chau in Sai Kung and a seven-year-old girl on the South Lantau Country Trail were rescued by Government Flying Service helicopter on Saturday afternoon as temperatures exceeded 38 degrees…

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣兩名行山者疑中暑 直升機救出包括7歲女童
zh.dek: 周六本港極端酷熱，新界部分地區氣溫超過38度，西貢破邊洲一名28歲男子及南大嶼山一名7歲女童先後懷疑中暑，由飛行服務隊直升機送往律敦治醫院。

en.headline: Very Hot Weather Warning remains in force as extreme heat continues
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory keeps the Very Hot Weather Warning active into Sunday, with mainly fine and extremely hot conditions expected and temperatures forecast to reach 36 degrees Celsius in urban areas.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告仍然生效 極端酷熱天氣持續
zh.dek: 天文台表示酷熱天氣警告於周日早上仍然生效，預料大致天晴，日間極端酷熱，市區最高氣溫約36度。

en.headline: Cebu Pacific flight returns to Hong Kong after suspected cargo door issue
en.dek: A Manila-bound Cebu Pacific Airbus A321 returned safely to Hong Kong International Airport on Saturday afternoon after its cargo door was suspected to have opened; no injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 宿霧太平洋航班疑貨艙門開啟 折返香港機場安全着陸
zh.dek: 一班由香港飛往馬尼拉的宿霧太平洋航空CEB143航班周六下午疑因貨艙門開啟問題折返香港國際機場，安全着陸無人受傷。

en.headline: Driver arrested after assaulting officer during Peak traffic stop
en.dek: A 55-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of assaulting a police officer and obstructing police after becoming agitated when stopped for failing to obey traffic signs on Peak Road on Saturday morning.

zh.headline: 山頂私家車違例被查 55歲司機襲警涉兩罪被捕
zh.dek: 山頂道一輛私家車今早未遵從交通標誌被截查，55歲姓蘇男司機情緒激動拒絕合作並襲擊男警，涉襲警及阻差辦公被捕。

en.headline: Bar Association broadly backs new persistent child sexual abuse offence
en.dek: The legal body said it supports introducing a dedicated offence while calling for safeguards to ensure fair trials, and also urged expanded pre-conviction anonymity for both complainants and defendants.

zh.headline: 大律師公會原則支持新增持續性侵犯兒童罪
zh.dek: 公會回應性罪行法例諮詢，原則同意增設相關罪行但須設保障措施確保公平審訊，並倡擴大定罪前匿名保護。

en.headline: Employer groups urge freeze on domestic helper minimum wage
en.dek: Two employer organisations petitioned the government on Saturday, citing a survey in which most respondents said they could not afford a rise and might dismiss helpers if wages increased.

zh.headline: 外傭僱主團體促凍結最低工資 稱加薪或致大量解僱
zh.dek: 兩個僱主團體周六向政府請願，指調查顯示逾九成僱主希望凍薪，八成半表示難以負擔加薪或考慮解僱外傭。

en.headline: Observatory records 34.7°C, hottest day of the year so far
en.dek: Under the influence of Severe Typhoon Dolphin’s outer subsiding air, temperatures exceeded 38 degrees in parts of the New Territories while the headquarters logged its highest reading of 2026.

zh.headline: 天文台錄34.7度創今年最高 上水高見38.5度
zh.dek: 受強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，本港極端酷熱，天文台總部錄得今年最高氣溫，新界多區超過37度。

en.headline: Bernadette Linn expects construction volume to rise with Northern Metropolis
en.dek: The Development Secretary told a construction industry awards ceremony that the sector needs talent skilled in advanced technology and AI as project workload is set to increase in the coming years.

zh.headline: 甯漢豪料北都發展帶動工程量上升
zh.dek: 發展局局長在建造業界頒獎禮表示，未來數年工程量持續上升，業界需積極裝備人才迎接前景。

en.headline: Paediatric expert says hard to predict flu peak, urges vaccination
en.dek: Dr Kwan Yat-wah said Hong Kong faces a triple epidemic of influenza, COVID-19 and RSV, and the recent child death from H3 influenza was an individual case that should not undermine vaccine confidence.

zh.headline: 關日華：難估計流感何時見頂 籲接種疫苗
zh.dek: 亞洲兒童傳染病學會會長指本港現受「三疫夾擊」，近期兒童甲流死亡屬個別事件，不應動搖對疫苗信心。

en.headline: Algernon Yau to lead mainland and Hong Kong firms on Malaysia visit next week
en.dek: The Commerce and Economic Development Secretary said the outbound specialist team has held more than 10 mainland promotion events and helped about 200 companies set up or expand in Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 丘應樺下周率內地及港企訪馬來西亞
zh.dek: 商經局局長表示出海專班已在內地辦逾10場推介，約200間企業來港設立或擴展業務，準備走出去。

en.headline: Man with knife wounds found in Wong Tai Sin lift; another dies after fall
en.dek: Police are investigating whether two incidents at Chiu Sin House in Wong Tai Sin Upper Estate on Saturday morning are linked, after a man with multiple cuts was found in a lift and another man was certified dead on a…

zh.headline: 黃大仙上邨電梯內發現刀傷男子 另一男墮樓死亡
zh.dek: 警方正調查黃大仙上邨昭善樓今早兩宗事故是否有關，一名男子在電梯內多處刀傷送院，另一名男子倒臥平台證實死亡。

en.headline: Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning issued this morning
en.dek: The Labour Department activated the Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning at 7am as heat-stress levels rose under the ongoing Very Hot Weather Warning, advising employers to arrange rest breaks for outdoor and…

zh.headline: 黃色工作暑熱警告今早生效
zh.dek: 勞工處上午7時發出黃色工作暑熱警告，表示部分工作環境熱壓力頗高；酷熱天氣警告同時生效，僱主應為戶外及無空調室內工作員工安排適當休息。

en.headline: Extreme heat continues under Very Hot Weather Warning
en.dek: The Observatory issued a special weather tip this morning warning of prolonged extremely hot conditions through the weekend and into next week, with some areas expected to reach 37 degrees or above.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告持續 天文台籲提防極端高溫
zh.dek: 天文台今早發出特別天氣提示，指受強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，極端酷熱天氣將持續至周末及下周一，部分地區氣溫可達37度或以上。

en.headline: Social Welfare Department warns of fake messaging accounts
en.dek: The department urged the public not to reply to or click links from messaging-app accounts purporting to represent SWD service centres, after detecting phishing attempts to harvest personal data.

zh.headline: 社署籲提防偽冒通訊應用程式帳戶
zh.dek: 社會福利署周五呼籲市民勿回覆自稱代表社署服務中心的通訊應用程式帳戶，或點擊不明連結，以免個人資料被盜。

en.headline: Couple found unconscious after swimming off Tuen Mun’s New Coffee Bay
en.dek: A 23-year-old man and his 20-year-old wife, both Pakistani holders of Hong Kong identity cards, were pulled from the sea near the shark net on Friday evening and remain in critical condition at Tuen Mun Hospital.

zh.headline: 屯門新咖啡灣夫婦嬉水遇溺 雙雙昏迷送院
zh.dek: 一對持香港身份證的巴基斯坦裔夫婦周五晚在新咖啡灣防鯊網附近遇溺，20歲妻子及23歲丈夫均陷入昏迷，送往屯門醫院時情況危殆。

en.headline: Chris Tang says Huanggang Port drills will involve up to 20,000 people
en.dek: The Security Bureau chief said progressive exercises starting next week will test traffic and passenger flows well above previous peak-hour levels before any decision on formal opening.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強：皇崗口岸演練將涉最多兩萬人
zh.dek: 保安局局長表示下星期起將進行遞增規模演練，最大一場涉及約兩萬人，遠超以往高峰人流後才決定正式開通日期。

en.headline: Man dies after suspected snorkelling accident off Sai Kung’s Hang Hau Chau
en.dek: A 58-year-old man was pulled unconscious from the sea near Hang Hau Chau on Friday afternoon and later certified dead at Tseung Kwan O Hospital; he had been out with colleagues on a private boat trip.

zh.headline: 西貢吊鐘洲男子浮潛疑遇溺不治
zh.dek: 一名58歲男子周五下午在西貢吊鐘洲對開海面被發現昏迷，送院後不治；他與同事出海遊船河期間落水浮潛。

en.headline: Wang Fuk Court probe: discarded cigarette most likely ignited deadly blaze
en.dek: The inter-departmental investigation team’s final report, uploaded by the independent committee, finds the fire probably started when an unextinguished cigarette butt set alight construction debris on a Wang Cheong…

zh.headline: 宏福苑跨部門最終報告：煙頭極可能引燃大火
zh.dek: 獨立委員會上載跨部門調查專組最終報告，指火勢極可能由未熄滅煙頭點燃宏昌閣平台堆積的建築雜物引起。

en.headline: Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning issued this afternoon
en.dek: The Labour Department activated the Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning around 1.15pm as heat-stress levels rose under the ongoing Very Hot Weather Warning, advising employers to arrange rest breaks for outdoor and…

zh.headline: 黃色工作暑熱警告下午生效
zh.dek: 勞工處下午約1時15分發出黃色工作暑熱警告，表示部分工作環境熱壓力頗高；酷熱天氣警告同時生效，僱主應安排適當休息時間。

en.headline: Tsuen Wan construction site water main burst sends jet tens of metres high
en.dek: An underground water pipe ruptured at a roadside works site on Guo Rui Road near Summit Terrace around 11am, producing a water column estimated at about ten storeys high; the Water Supplies Department is carrying out…

zh.headline: 荃灣國瑞路工地爆水管 水柱高約十層樓
zh.dek: 周五上午11時許，荃灣國瑞路近昇柏山對開路邊工地有地底水管爆裂，水柱噴高約十層樓，水務署已到場關掣搶修。

en.headline: Woman loses nearly HK$69 million to scammers posing as mainland officials
en.dek: A 43-year-old Hong Kong woman transferred about HK$68.9 million over a month after callers claiming to be mainland law-enforcement officers accused her of a crime and demanded money to prove her innocence.

zh.headline: 女子墮假冒內地官員騙局 損失近6,900萬元
zh.dek: 一名43歲香港女子接獲自稱內地執法人員來電，指她涉案並要求轉帳「保證金」，一個月內合共轉出約6,890萬元至指定帳戶。

en.headline: HKMCA authorises BOC Life intermediaries to refer annuity plan
en.dek: Designated licensed insurance intermediaries of BOC Group Life Assurance may now introduce the HKMC Annuity Plan to customers and refer eligible clients under a new partnership announced Friday.

zh.headline: 年金公司與中銀人壽合作 授權中介介紹年金計劃
zh.dek: 香港按揭證券有限公司全資附屬的年金公司周五公布，中銀人壽指定持牌保險中介可向客戶介紹年金計劃並轉介合資格客戶。

en.headline: North Point water main burst disrupts supply on Fuk Yan Road
en.dek: A 250 mm fresh-water main burst at the junction of King Wah Road and Fuk Yan Road early Friday, cutting supply to nearby residences and shops; most service was restored by late morning with repairs continuing.

zh.headline: 北角福蔭道食水管爆裂 附近一度停水
zh.dek: 周五早上京華道與福蔭道交界一條250毫米食水管爆裂，附近住宅及食肆食水供應受影響，大部分用戶上午已恢復，搶修仍在進行。

en.headline: Government gazettes water recreation and yacht bay works near airport
en.dek: Proposed works by the Airport Authority in the bay between the airport, the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port and Tung Chung aim to create leisure and tourism facilities, with construction tentatively from…

zh.headline: 政府刊憲機場附近水上康樂及遊艇港灣工程
zh.dek: 機管局擬於機場、港珠澳大橋香港口岸與東涌之間海灣進行水上康樂及遊艇港灣發展工程，暫訂2027年展開、2030年完成。

en.headline: Election Committee subsector polls set for 22 November
en.dek: The Chief Executive has gazetted Sunday 22 November as the polling day for the 2026 Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections, with nominations running from 7 to 20 October.

zh.headline: 選委會界別分組選舉投票日定11月22日
zh.dek: 行政長官已刊憲指明2026年11月22日為選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉投票日，提名期由10月7日至20日。

en.headline: Law Society urges ‘law comes first’ in five-year plan submission
en.dek: The professional body submitted recommendations stressing that economic and social development must rest on a clear, predictable and internationally credible legal framework, and offered proposals on the Northern…

zh.headline: 律師會就五年規劃提交建議 強調「法律先行」
zh.dek: 律師會在意見書中強調經濟與社會發展願景須以清晰、可預測及具國際公信力的法律框架為基礎，並就北部都會區、仲裁及體育法等提出建議。

en.headline: Man arrested over H8 building sprinkler attack that disabled three lifts
en.dek: A 21-year-old man was arrested after a fire sprinkler head was smashed with a baseball bat on 1 August, flooding lift shafts at the Tsim Sha Tsui commercial building and putting all three lifts out of service for days.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀H8大廈花灑遭棒球棍破壞 21歲男子被捕
zh.dek: 一名21歲男子涉於8月1日以棒球棍擊毀消防花灑頭，導致三部升降機入水停運多日，警方已拘捕該男子並追緝另外四人。

en.headline: Police arrest 15 after Kwun Tong drug den raid
en.dek: Officers raided a unit on Shui Wo Street on Thursday, seizing suspected heroin, ice and other drugs with an estimated value of about HK$120,000; a 43-year-old woman was arrested for operating a drug den and trafficking.

zh.headline: 觀塘毒窟搜查 警拘15人檢約12萬元毒品
zh.dek: 警方周四在瑞和街一單位搜查，檢獲懷疑海洛英、冰毒等，市值約12萬元；一名43歲女子涉經營毒窟及販毒被捕。

en.headline: Lingnan University Students’ Union announces dissolution after 59 years
en.dek: The union said campus and external conditions had changed and it had taken the difficult decision to dissolve after a joint meeting, leaving only a handful of active student unions among the eight publicly funded…

zh.headline: 嶺南大學學生會宣布解散 結束近59年運作
zh.dek: 學生會稱近年校園內外形勢出現變化，經聯席會議通過後作出解散的艱難決定，八大資助大學僅剩少數學生會仍在運作。

en.headline: Very hot weather to continue, extremely hot over weekend
en.dek: The Observatory warns of prolonged high temperatures with parts of the New Territories expected to reach 36 degrees or above under the influence of outer subsiding air from Tropical Cyclone Dolphin.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣持續 周末部分地區極端酷熱
zh.dek: 天文台指出受熱帶氣旋白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，未來數日高溫持續，周末新界部分地區氣溫可達36度或以上。

en.headline: Happy Valley estate pool closed over suspected fake lifeguard certificate
en.dek: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department ordered the immediate closure of a private swimming pool after a lifeguard’s credentials failed to match official records.

zh.headline: 跑馬地屋苑泳池疑用假救生員證 食環署令即時關閉
zh.dek: 食環署發現跑馬地雲地利道私人屋苑持牌泳池有救生員使用虛假證件，已指令泳池即時關閉，並考慮檢控持牌人。

en.headline: Alice Mak says Care Teams now key part of district governance
en.dek: The Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs told a training session for team leaders that the Care Teams, together with District Councils and the three committees, form the “three carriages” of local governance after…

zh.headline: 麥美娟：關愛隊已成地區治理重要一環
zh.dek: 民政及青年事務局局長在關愛隊培訓班表示，關愛隊成立三年已成為完善地區治理架構重要部分，與區議會及「三會」組成「三駕馬車」。

en.headline: Chan Kwok-ki inspects Huanggang Port, demands highest standards for drills
en.dek: The Chief Secretary visited the Hong Kong-side facilities on Thursday afternoon and said the inter-departmental team must complete more than 100 exercises and tests to the highest standard before the redeveloped…

zh.headline: 陳國基視察皇崗口岸 要求演練達最高標準
zh.dek: 政務司司長周四下午到港方口岸區實地視察，強調跨部門小組必須以最高標準完成逾百項演練及測試，確保通關安全暢順後才正式開通。

en.headline: CFS finds pre-packaged black cod exceeding methylmercury limit
en.dek: A sample of Alaska Seafood U.S. Alaska Black Cod Steak contained 0.8 mg/kg of methylmercury, above the legal limit of 0.5 mg/kg; the Centre for Food Safety ordered the affected batch withdrawn from sale and recalled.

zh.headline: 食安中心檢銀鱈魚扒甲基汞超標 受影響批次須下架回收
zh.dek: 一個預先包裝美國銀鱈魚扒樣本甲基汞含量每公斤0.8毫克，超出法例上限0.5毫克；食安中心已指令停售下架，進口商正回收。

en.headline: Bus driver arrested after motorcyclist critically injured in Tung Chung crash
en.dek: A 58-year-old motorcyclist was trapped under a bus and left unconscious after a collision at Tung Chung East Interchange on Thursday evening; the 60-year-old bus driver was arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving…

zh.headline: 東涌巴士電單車相撞 鐵騎士重傷昏迷 車長被捕
zh.dek: 周四傍晚東涌東交匯處一輛龍運巴士與電單車相撞，58歲鐵騎士被捲入車底拖行後昏迷送院，60歲巴士車長涉危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害被捕。

en.headline: Customs seizes 8.12 million illicit cigarettes in two sea-container cases
en.dek: Officers arrested three local men after finding cigarettes hidden in a container declared as lifeboats from Singapore and another from South Korea declared as toiletries, with a combined estimated market value of…

zh.headline: 海關破兩宗海路私煙案 檢約812萬支拘3人
zh.dek: 關員在葵涌貨櫃碼頭先後截獲由新加坡及南韓抵港的貨櫃，分別以救生艇及牙膏護膚品作掩飾，共檢約812萬支懷疑未完稅香煙，市值約3700萬元。

en.headline: Government launches new silver bonds with 4.25% guaranteed rate
en.dek: The 11th batch targets HK$50 billion and may rise to HK$55 billion; applications open 21 August for residents born in or before 1967, with issuance on 15 September.

zh.headline: 新一批銀色債券保證息率4.25厘 最高發行額550億
zh.dek: 第11批銀債目標發行額500億元，可視乎認購反應上調至550億元；1967年或之前出生居民可於8月21日起認購，9月15日發行。
